subject: MAP: Finalize POC environment gating - API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@caretraq.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP kickoff: POC environment gating and final access checklist

Alex —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our MAP, we want to lock down the final environment gating so your engineers can start load testing next week. Summary of the minimum deliverables we need from CareTraq to get the POC fully active inside the MAP: 

- Organization/tenant created and an owner assigned (we will need the org id).
- API keys: test key + a scoped non-production integration key (we'll provide scopes).
- IP allowlist: static egress CIDRs for your staging runners (two blocks preferred).
- VPC peering: peering request + required route table permissions (we've attached a template).

Action items / timeline suggested by Redwood: 
1) Today: CareTraq confirms org owner + procurement timeline.
2) By Thu 2025-12-11: Provide API key request form and CIDRs.
3) By Mon 2025-12-15: Initiate VPC peering request and complete security questionnaire (if not already).

If that timeline looks OK I'll convert this into the MAP row in the shared playbook and loop in Neha for security gating details.

Quick note: I attached the MAP checklist and the VPC peering template we discussed.

Thanks,
Jonas
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: map-checklist-v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
[Attachment: vpc-peering-template.yaml (text/yaml)]

From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@caretraq.io>

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: POC environment gating and final access checklist

Jonas —

Appreciate the clear checklist. Quick answers and clarifications from our side:

- Org owner: created (org id: ctrq-staging-09). Owner is me (Alex Moreno).
- API keys: procurement wants the exact scopes you will require for the non-prod integration key before they approve. Can you send the scope doc?
- IP allowlist: staging runners currently egress from 34.120.0.0/18 and 35.202.128.0/17 — is that OK?
- VPC peering: our networking team will submit the request but they need the CIDR of your peering side and the template filled with the accepted ASG names.

Timeline constraints: procurement needs an SOW reference for any reserved capacity. If we keep this within evaluation credits I expect procurement will sign off faster.

I'll schedule a 30-min call with our SRE and procurement for Thursday afternoon to walk through scope + SOW expectations.

—Alex
VP Product, CareTraq

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: POC environment gating and final access checklist — scopes & peering details

Alex / team —

Thanks for the details. Below are the minimum scopes and the peering info for the POC environment. I'm also attaching a short security pre-fill to accelerate procurement.

Minimum API scopes (POC non-prod key):
- generation.read
- generation.write (rate-limited to 20 TPS for the key)
- embeddings.read
- usage.metrics.read (for token billing dashboard)

Notes: the non-prod integration key will be restricted to the org id ctrq-staging-09 and to the IP allowlist you provided (34.120.0.0/18, 35.202.128.0/17). If you prefer a narrower subset for testing we can support that.

Redwood peering details (to paste into your networking request):
- Redwood POC VPC CIDR: 10.42.0.0/16
- Expected peering type: VPC peering (AWS) / Shared VPC (GCP) — we will match what your cloud team prefers.
- Route table change required: allow 10.42.0.0/16 <-> your staging CIDRs.
- Asg / tag guidance: redwood-poc-asg-01, redwood-poc-bastion (these are the names our template uses).

Security pre-fill doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_Map_Playbook (we added the SOC2 pointer and data handling notes).

Next steps: once you confirm the procurement path (evaluation credits vs SOW), we will issue the scoped non-prod key and open the peering. Happy to join Thursday's call.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: security-prefill-caretraq.pdf (application/pdf)]
